Svartifoss

Self-hosted F-Droid repo for Svartifoss, a Wear OS remote for phone music playback. Not distributed through the official F-Droid repo because it depends on Google Play Services (Wearable Data Layer API) and optionally Firebase for crash reporting/analytics.

Currently it serves 1 apps. To add it to your F-Droid app, scan the QR code (click it to enlarge) or use this link:

https://gabrielluizone.github.io/Svartifoss/fdroid/repo
